children: Canada telecom and media firm's Q3 revenue grew 2%, slightly beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Company completed MLSE minority stake acquisition, now owns 100% of MLSE
Rogers reaffirms 2026 outlook for service revenue, adjusted EBITDA, capex, and free cash flow
Company plans to sell minority stake in sports/media assets by H1 2027 to repay debt
Company expects free cash flow to support accelerated debt repayment
WIRELESS REVENUE PRESSURE - Co said wireless service revenue declined due to lower ARPU from competitive intensity and regulatory fee changes
MEDIA GROWTH - Higher sports and subscriber revenue drove media segment growth, partly offset by lower non-sports advertising
CABLE STABILITY - Retail Internet subscriber growth and base management offset declines in Home Phone and Video subscribers
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
